bio.text: Rebecca Bauer-Kahan was first elected to represent Assembly District 16 in the California State Assembly in 2018; the district includes Danville, Dublin, Lafayette, Livermore, Pleasanton, San Ramon and Walnut Creek.
She is a Bay Area native and an attorney who worked on environmental compliance and on intellectual property cases for technology companies.
In the Assembly she is a former Chair of the Committee on Water, Parks, and Wildlife and the founder and Chair of the Select Committee on Reproductive Health.
